statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; ∀ (q n : ℕ), 0 < q → let D := fun r : ℕ => if Nat.Coprime r q then (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r), Λ k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q else 0; (∑ a ∈ Finset.range q, ‖∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (D r:ℂ)*E ((a:ℝ)*r/q)‖^2) = (q:ℝ)*(∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (D r)^2)

plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8004 · Recover the unit-class variance from the rational-frequency energy

brief.zh: 对所有分子取平方均值并用加法正交。非单位类按零延拓。用于检验频率预算，3/5 水平的逐类最大误差及模数和另需输入。
brief.en: Sum over every numerator and apply additive orthogonality with zero extension on nonunits. The maximum class error and the sum over moduli at level 3/5 need additional bounds.
